versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.2 of uexcorp-sc

- No user-facing or backend changes detected in this version.
- All endpoints, documentation, and workflows remain unchanged.
- No updates to feature set, API integration, or behavioral guidelines.

Version 1.1.1 of uexcorp-sc

- Added detailed documentation for UEXcorp marketplace listing endpoints and workflows, including creation, deletion, and troubleshooting of listings with images.
- Clarified required headers for marketplace actions, including distinction between `Authorization` token and `secret-key`.
- Provided sample payload and notes on sandbox vs. production image upload reliability.
- No changes to the code/API integrations; documentation update only.

No user-facing changes in this release.

- No file or documentation changes were detected.
- Core functionality and behavior remain the same as the previous version.

Major update: Now focused on managing your personal Star Citizen trades, inventory, and aUEC balance.

- Added support for tracking personal trade history, inventory, and in-game credits via new API endpoints.
- Public data lookups (commodities, terminals, prices) are now mainly used to assist personal record-keeping.
- Example interactions updated to reflect focus on logging and reviewing your own trades and inventory.
- All requests require token authentication, with rate-limiting guidance.
- UEXcorp data is still noted as community-sourced and may differ slightly from live game values.

- Expanded documentation to include many new UEXcorp API endpoints, such as historical prices, prices across all terminals, vehicle rentals, item attributes, and trade route calculations.
- Updated endpoint listings for wider Star Citizen economy coverage, including commodities, items, terminals, ships, routes, and status.
- Added detailed descriptions for each endpoint to improve clarity on data retrieval.
- No implementation or file changes; documentation only.

UEXcorp Star Citizen Trade Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release for Star Citizen commodity trading assistance.
- Query live trade data from the UEXcorp API: commodity prices, trade routes, mining materials, and ship components.
- Markdown tables provided for multi-result queries; optimized for clarity and comparison.
- Full instructions for authentication, rate limits, and endpoint use included.
- Guidance for best trade route, cheapest/highest buy/sell locations, and handling unknown terminals.
- Fallback to the latest UEXcorp documentation for unsupported or unclear user requests.
